title: The clean-account setup run is a repository script, so the fresh-host report can be re-run
goal: A PowerShell script in _tools/ (run elevated on a Windows host) creates a temporary local standard account with a random in-memory password, runs install-python.ps1 and the /kb-setup commands that need no sign-in as that account from a bundle of origin/main, writes each step's exit code and last line, and deletes the account, its profile and its work folder; a -Short switch leaves out the test suites; kb/_self/tools.md and kb/_self/reports/windows-fresh-host.md name it; a test parses it with the PowerShell parser on Windows and checks it prints no password. Failure it answers (SP-hlfwfcx6 retrospective): the three runs behind the report came from scripts in a session's scratchpad, so no one else could re-run them.
